standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: I'm busy here. Do you need something?

options.text: Please tell me about what you're doing.

steps.player: Please tell me about what you're doing.

steps.npc: Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.
I'm in charge of the investigations unit. Sometimes an informant will let us know when a gang is meeting. Then we can send in the troops and get them.
That would be very welcome. Information about gang meetings is written on the notice board when it's received. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
If they drop any documents, bring them to me for an extra reward.

options.text: Do you know of any meetings now?
You sound busy. I'll be off.
You sound busy. I'll be off.

steps.player: You sound busy. I'll be off.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Hello again. Thanks for offering to help deal with the criminal gangs.

options.text: Do you know of any meetings now?

steps.player: Do you know of any meetings now?

steps.text: If there are no gang meetings active:

steps.npc: No, not at the moment. Keep checking the notice board - information is written there when we receive it.

steps.text: If there are are gang meetings active:

steps.npc: We've received reports of a gang [in location]! They're meeting [in location].

steps.text: If the meeting is in progress:

steps.npc: We believe the meeting is in progress now.

steps.text: If the meeting is about to start:

steps.npc: We believe the meeting is about to start imminently.
We believe the meeting will start in about [number] minutes.

options.text: Remind me, what do I do for this?

steps.player: Remind me, what do I do for this?

steps.npc: Gang meeting information is written on the notice board when it's received from the informants. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
If they drop any documents, bring them to me for an extra reward.

options.text: Do you know of any meetings now?

checking-the-information-board-before-ta.npc: Come over here and talk to me before you mess around with that.

using-items-on-her-any-other-item.npc: No thanks, I don't need that.

delivering-intelligence.text: Captain Ginea exchanges your [x] intelligence documents for training manuals.
If the player has talked to Captain Ginea about organised crime:

steps.npc: Thank you. This will help us track down more gang meetings in future.

delivering-intelligence.text: If the player has not talked to Captain Ginea about organised crime:

steps.npc: I don't remember asking you to help, but... okay, thank you, whoever you are.

historical-dialogue-if-the-player-does-n.npc: Please leave. There is confidential information in here, and you are not authorised to view it.
